chapter_description.p: The GUI module provides functions to create and interact with graphical user interface components, dialogs, and application windows.

keyword.name: commandhistory
keyword.description: Command History

keyword.name: dialog
keyword.description: Creates a dialog figure window.

keyword.name: errordlg
keyword.description: Creates an error dialog box.

keyword.name: filebrowser
keyword.description: Current Folder Browser

keyword.name: helpdlg
keyword.description: Creates a help dialog box.

keyword.name: inputdlg
keyword.description: Opens an input dialog box.

keyword.name: inserthtml
keyword.description: Insert html in GUI console.

keyword.name: listdlg
keyword.description: Opens a list selection dialog box.

keyword.name: lookandfeel
keyword.description: default current application look and feel.

keyword.name: msgbox
keyword.description: Creates a message dialog box.

keyword.name: openvar
keyword.description: Open variable in the Variable Editor

keyword.name: qt_verbose
keyword.description: show/hide Qt debug message.

keyword.name: questdlg
keyword.description: Creates a question dialog box.

keyword.name: terminal
keyword.description: Shell terminal in GUI mode

keyword.name: uialert
keyword.description: Displays an alert dialog for a UI figure.

keyword.name: uiconfirm

keyword.description: Create a figure for app-style user interfaces.
